scope: Every checked parser rule, nested choice and optional/repetition 0/1/2 boundary; actual public compiler profiles and finite reviewed negative cases. Lexer token boundaries have separate explicit cases. This does not execute an authority.

relational.behavior: Pure Table relational parsing and exact schema binding, including EXPLAIN prefix routing; no source capture or execution.

query.behavior: Pure SELECT compilation against the explicit fixture schema. No inspection, mutations, publication or authority access.

template.behavior: Pure typed template construction; no implicit execution or binding.

mutation.behavior: Pure schema-bound general typed DML compilation; stored uniqueness and atomic publication have separate runtime proofs.

declaration.behavior: Offline KV/Document definition compilation; no publication.

application.behavior: Offline complete application parsing and graph validation; no publication.

table_ddl.behavior: General Table CREATE/ALTER/DROP compilation with explicit captured schema; no authority or publication.

authorization.behavior: Pure selected role/schema/privilege parsing. Native identity resolution, current authorization and durable publication have separate owners and proofs.

settings.behavior: Pure shared settings plans and typed metadata compilation; no reads, authority checks or reload dispatch.

transaction.behavior: Pure shared transaction-control parser. No admission, private statement execution or durable decision.

log_ddl.behavior: Pure Stream/Queue CREATE/ALTER/DROP compilation, including CREATE policy binding. ALTER policy evolution, current authority and publication have separate checks.

log_inspection.behavior: Pure named Stream/Queue SHOW/DESCRIBE syntax used by the SQL service. No definition lookup or disclosure.

table_query.behavior: Pure scalar SELECT compilation against an explicit logical Table schema and its exact semantic descriptors; no acquisition or execution.

historical_selector.behavior: Pure extraction and canonical decoding of a historical selector before inner-statement compilation. No catalog binding, authority or retention is claimed.
